The moccasins offer a grounded, comfortable finish suitable for dancing or mingling, and the bag completes your look with understated sophistication. The outfit creates a vertical line that elongates your figure, balancing the volume of the skirt and coat without adding unnecessary bulk.\", \"how_to_wear\": [\"Leave the collar of the coat open to create a relaxed fourth state, softening the structure for a celebratory vibe.\", \"Tuck the shirt loosely into the skirt to define the waist subtly and connect the top and bottom seamlessly.\"], \"wrong_photos\": [], \"swap\": {}, \"named\": [{\"n\": \"#30·04\", \"what\": \"outerwear\"}, {\"n\": \"#267·31\", \"what\": \"bottom\"}, {\"n\": \"#32·09\", \"what\": \"top\"}, {\"n\": \"#64·10\", \"what\": \"shoes\"}, {\"n\": \"#42·37\", \"what\": \"bag\"}], \"about_items\": [{\"n\": \"#30·04\", \"text\": \"This coat provides the essential outer layer for your celebration, its structure framing you elegantly while allowing the collar to be worn open for a relaxed yet polished look.\"}, {\"n\": \"#267·31\", \"text\": \"The skirt flows gracefully over your lower body, adding the necessary movement and softness to balance the sharper lines of the outerwear without overwhelming your frame.\"}, {\"n\": \"#32·09\", \"text\": \"This shirt serves as your comfortable core piece, its lighter fabric contrasting nicely with the coat to keep you feeling cool under lights while maintaining a clean, fitted silhouette at the waist.\"}, {\"n\": \"#64·10\", \"text\": \"These moccasins ground your outfit with understated comfort and style, perfect for moving through an event without sacrificing sophistication or ease of movement.\"}, {\"n\": \"#42·37\", \"text\": \"This bag carries your essentials with a versatile shape that complements the outfit's relaxed elegance, ensuring you can hold your drink or phone while keeping your hands free to dance.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":3754,"output_tokens":484},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
